text: Neurology is an important secondary discipline of clinical medicine, mainly studying diseases of the central nervous system (brain, spinal cord), peripheral nervous system and muscle tissues, covering the etiology, pathology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases. Its core objective is to address the threat of neurological diseases to human health through scientific methods, covering multiple fields such as cerebrovascular diseases, neurodegenerative diseases (such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease), epilepsy, peripheral neuropathy, and muscle diseases.
